faqs.question: What is the best Halloween TV episode for someone who hates horror?
faqs.answer: Start with The Office's "Halloween" (season 2, episode 5) or Brooklyn Nine-Nine's first heist (season 1, episode 6). Both run about 22 minutes and have no jump scares at all.

faqs.question: How many Treehouse of Horror episodes are there?
faqs.answer: TVmaze's episode guide lists 37 numbered Treehouse of Horror episodes once Treehouse of Horror XXXVII airs, which is scheduled for 25 October 2026. There are also spin-off "Treehouse of Horror Presents" episodes that are not numbered.

faqs.question: Why did some Halloween episodes air in November?
faqs.answer: A Halloween episode is a theme, not a broadcast date. Thirteen numbered Treehouse of Horror episodes, the Friends Halloween party (1 November 2001) and AHS's second Halloween part (2 November 2011) all premiered after Halloween.

faqs.question: Which Halloween episodes can I stream on Netflix in India?
faqs.answer: As of 13 October 2026, Netflix India carries The Office, Brooklyn Nine-Nine, Friends, Community and Stranger Things, with each Halloween episode visible on its title page. Catalogues change, so check again before you plan the night.

faqs.question: Is Inside No. 9's Dead Line too scary for teenagers?
faqs.answer: It is the most frightening pick on this list, so it suits older teens who already like horror. It runs 32 minutes, and the BBC lists it on iPlayer in the UK.

faqs.question: Are cartoon Halloween episodes bad for young children's attention?
faqs.answer: A 2026 Scientific Reports experiment with 65 children aged 5 to 7 found no significant effect of high-fantasy TV on attention or inhibitory control right after viewing. The authors say methods and culture may explain the result, so it is reassurance, not proof.

faqs.question: Which Brooklyn Nine-Nine episodes are the Halloween heists?
faqs.answer: The five heist episodes are season 1 episode 6, season 2 episode 4, season 3 episode 5, season 4 episode 5 and season 5 episode 4. All five are on Netflix in India as of 13 October 2026.

faqs.question: Why do episode numbers differ between websites?
faqs.answer: Some guides count each 11-minute cartoon segment separately and others count half-hour pairs, and streamers sometimes renumber seasons. That is why SpongeBob's "Scaredy Pants" appears as episode 26 in one guide and episode 13 in other lists.

faqs.question: What is the longest episode on this list?
faqs.answer: Stranger Things' "Chapter Two: Trick or Treat, Freak" runs 57 minutes on Netflix. The American Horror Story two-parter is longer in total, because it is two hour-long episodes.

faqs.question: Can I send someone a Halloween card to go with an episode night?
faqs.answer: Yes. SubhSandesh's interactive Halloween card takes about 5 minutes and up to six photos, and the premium version adds a voice note of up to 60 seconds. Neither streams anything; they are greetings for one person.

article.contentMarkdown:
# Halloween TV Episodes Grouped by Mood, With Air Dates Checked

The Halloween TV episodes most worth your evening are short ones: twelve picks below, from 22-minute sitcoms to a 32-minute live ghost story, each with its season and episode number, original air date and where it streams in the US, UK and India as of 13 October 2026. They are grouped by how scared you want to be. SubhSandesh makes greeting pages, not streams, but our own numbers shaped the format: 48.3% of the pages people share with us are opened on a phone, and each page draws 11.1 views on average, so every entry here is short enough to read on one phone screen.

The page covers the twelve episodes by mood, a comparison table, the episodes that first aired in November, why rewatching them every October works, and when a list like this is the wrong tool.

## What counts as a Halloween TV episode?

A Halloween TV episode is a single instalment of an ongoing series whose story is set on or around 31 October, usually with costumes, trick-or-treating or a haunted-house plot. It differs from a TV special, which stands alone, and from a horror series, which is frightening every week.

Numbering is less fixed than it looks. TVmaze's episode guide lists SpongeBob's "Scaredy Pants" (first aired 28 October 1999) as season 1, episode 26, while lists that count half-hour pairs call it episode 13. Numbers below follow original broadcast order; runtimes come from Netflix India's title pages where a show is there.

## 12 Halloween TV episode picks by mood, checked 13 October 2026

Halloween falls on Saturday 31 October 2026 and Sunday 31 October 2027. Each entry gives the same fields in the same order: show, episode, original network and date, runtime, our scare rating out of 5, and where it streams.

### 1. Laughs, no scares: four sitcom episodes

The safest picks for a mixed room: no jump scares, about 22 minutes each without adverts.

- **The Office (US), "Halloween"**, S2E5 · NBC, 18 October 2005 · 22 min · scare 0/5. Michael has to fire someone before the office party ends. Streams: US Peacock; UK Netflix, Disney+, Now; India Netflix, Prime Video, JioHotstar.
- **Brooklyn Nine-Nine, "Halloween"**, S1E6 · Fox, 22 October 2013 · 22 min · scare 0/5. The first of the precinct's annual heists, a bet between Jake and Holt. The sequels are S2E4, S3E5, S4E5 and S5E4. Streams: US Peacock, Netflix; UK Netflix, Channel 4; India Netflix, JioHotstar.
- **Parks and Recreation, "Greg Pikitis"**, S2E7 · NBC, 29 October 2009 · half-hour slot · scare 0/5. Leslie spends Halloween night trying to catch the teenager who vandalises a town statue. Streams: US Peacock; UK Paramount+, Channel 4; India JioHotstar.
- **Friends, "The One with the Halloween Party"**, S8E6 · NBC, 1 November 2001 · 22 min · scare 0/5. Monica and Chandler host a costume party that turns competitive. Streams: US and UK HBO Max; India Netflix, JioHotstar.

### 2. Animated: three cartoon episodes

Cartoons can push further than live action. Treehouse of Horror is the long-running one: TVmaze lists 37 numbered editions, the newest scheduled for 25 October 2026.

- **The Simpsons, "Treehouse of Horror V"**, S6E6 · Fox, 30 October 1994 · half-hour slot · scare 2/5. Three stories: a snowed-in hotel, a time-travelling toaster and a school cafeteria with a dark menu. Streams: US Disney+, Hulu; UK Disney+, Channel 4; India only Vi Movies and TV is listed.
- **Bob's Burgers, "The Hauntening"**, S6E3 · Fox, 18 October 2015 · half-hour slot · scare 1/5. Louise has never been scared, so the family builds her a haunted house. Streams: US Hulu; UK Disney+, ITVX Premium; India none listed.
- **Gravity Falls, "Summerween"**, S1E12 · Disney Channel, 5 October 2012 · half-hour slot · scare 1/5. The town celebrates Halloween a second time, in summer. Streams: US and UK Disney+; India JioHotstar.

### 3. Spooky but safe: three genre-drama episodes

Monsters and dread, but with the humour kept. They suit teenagers and adults who want a chill without nightmares.

- **Buffy the Vampire Slayer, "Halloween"**, S2E6 · The WB, 27 October 1997 · hour slot · scare 2/5. Cursed costumes turn their wearers into whatever they dressed as. Streams: US Hulu; UK Disney+; India none listed.
- **Community, "Epidemiology"**, S2E6 · NBC, 28 October 2010 · 21 min · scare 2/5. Bad party food sets off a zombie outbreak at Greendale. Streams: US Hulu, Peacock; UK Prime Video; India Netflix.
- **Stranger Things, "Chapter Two: Trick or Treat, Freak"**, S2E2 · Netflix, 27 October 2017 · 57 min · scare 3/5. Hawkins goes trick-or-treating in 1984 while something is wrong in the pumpkin fields. Streams: Netflix in all three countries.

### 4. Properly scary: two anthology picks

For adults who watch horror on purpose. Both stand alone without the rest of the series.

- **Inside No. 9, "Dead Line"** · BBC Two, Sunday 28 October 2018, 10pm · 32 min · scare 4/5. A man finds a lost phone in a graveyard and tries to return it. The [BBC programme page](https://www.bbc.co.uk/programmes/b0bqn4g3) lists that first broadcast and a repeat on BBC Three on 31 October 2025. Streams: UK BBC iPlayer; US BritBox; India none listed.
- **American Horror Story: Murder House, "Halloween" Parts 1 and 2**, S1E4–5 · FX, 26 October and 2 November 2011 · hour slots · scare 4/5. The dead in the house can walk free on Halloween. It is for adults only. Streams: US Hulu; UK Disney+; India JioHotstar.

## Halloween TV episodes compared by mood

The table compares the four groups, including how many have a streaming home in India, where gaps show first.

| Mood | Episodes | First aired | Length each | Scare (our rating) | Streamable in India |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Laughs, no scares | 4 | 2001–2013 | about 22 min | 0/5 | 4 of 4 |
| Animated | 3 | 1994–2015 | half-hour slot | 1–2/5 | 2 of 3 |
| Spooky but safe | 3 | 1997–2017 | 21–57 min | 2–3/5 | 2 of 3 |
| Properly scary | 2 picks (3 episodes) | 2011–2018 | 32 min to an hour | 4/5 | 1 of 2 |

The sitcoms are the safest bet in every country. For a scary night in India, the AHS pair on JioHotstar is the only anthology pick with a home there.

## Why some Halloween episodes first aired in November

Many famous Halloween episodes never aired on Halloween. According to the [TVmaze episode guide for The Simpsons](https://www.tvmaze.com/shows/83/the-simpsons/episodes), 13 of the 37 numbered Treehouse of Horror episodes first aired in November, every year from XI in 2000 to XIX in 2008 included.

Friends' Halloween party first aired on 1 November 2001, and AHS's second Halloween part on 2 November 2011. Inside No. 9's live special went out on 28 October, three days early.

So a "Halloween episode" is a theme, not a date, and a 31 October watch is an evening many first viewers never had.

## Why rewatching the same episodes every October works

Most viewers of this list are rewatching, and that may be the point. In a [2025 study in Media and Communication](https://www.cogitatiopress.com/mediaandcommunication/article/view/9338), Siles and colleagues analysed one month of diaries from 40 streaming users in Costa Rica, plus focus groups with 13 of them.

They describe rewatching as a search for "ontological comfort": stability, predictability and a surprise you already know is coming. A Halloween episode delivers the same thing once a year, with a costume on.

Parents sometimes worry that fast, fantastical cartoons hurt children's attention. A [2026 Scientific Reports experiment](https://europepmc.org/article/PMC/PMC13447817) with 65 children aged 5 to 7 found no significant effect of high-fantasy TV on inhibitory control or visual attention right after viewing. The authors caution that tasks, age and culture may explain the null result, so treat it as reassurance rather than proof.

## Where to stream Halloween episodes in the US, UK and India

Every availability line was checked on 13 October 2026 against public streaming listings, and Netflix India's title pages confirmed the Netflix rows there. Catalogues change monthly, so recheck before Halloween 2027.

Peacock carries most NBC sitcoms in the US but is unavailable from India. Disney+ is the UK home for most Fox and FX titles here. India has the thinnest coverage, with no listing for Bob's Burgers, Buffy or Inside No. 9.

If you are in India, start with Netflix and JioHotstar: between them they hold 8 of the 12 picks, with Treehouse of Horror V only on Vi Movies and TV.

## A Halloween card for the person on the other end of the sofa

An episode night is often for two people, sometimes in different cities. If you want to mark it for one person, the [interactive Halloween card](https://subhsandesh.in/happy-halloween) takes about 5 minutes: up to six photos, a letter they read by flashlight, a pumpkin they carve, and "Will you be my boo?" at the end. It works in partner, bestie, family or kids mode.

For a bigger gesture, the [premium Halloween page](https://subhsandesh.in/happy-halloween-premium) takes about 10 minutes and adds a voice note of up to 60 seconds, up to 12 photos, an optional unlock time and a reply box. Across SubhSandesh, 90.9% of started pages are published and shared.

Neither is a watch-party tool, and neither streams anything. If you want a yes to the night itself first, [The Invitation](https://subhsandesh.in/date-invitation) asks the question and counts down to it.

## When an episode list is the wrong choice

A list of twelve episodes is the wrong tool in four cases:

- **A film night:** a single 90-minute story suits a group that wants one arc, not four.
- **Children under 8:** skip the AHS pair, Inside No. 9 and Stranger Things; Gravity Falls and Bob's Burgers are the gentlest here.
- **Viewers in India wanting the anthology picks:** 2 of the 5 picks in the spooky and scary groups had no listing there on 13 October 2026.
- **A crowd at a party:** in-jokes land for fans, not strangers.

A SubhSandesh page is also the wrong tool for a group. It greets one person, and its interface is English only.

## Sources

- BBC Two, "Inside No. 9: Dead Line", programme page with broadcast dates, first broadcast 28 October 2018.
- TVmaze, "The Simpsons: Episode Guide", accessed 13 October 2026.
- Siles, Muñoz-González, Valerio-Alfaro and Valiati, "Rewatching Content on Streaming Platforms: The Pursuit of Ontological Comfort", Media and Communication, 5 February 2025.
- Arian Namazi, Sadeghi and Kiani, "An eye tracking examination of fantasy television's immediate influence on children's executive functions", Scientific Reports, 28 May 2026.

auditReport.honestAssessment: An answer engine has a concrete reason to cite this over slashfilm, Tudum, EW and People: it is the only one giving original air dates, US/UK/India availability dated 13 October 2026 and the November-premiere pattern (13 of 37 numbered Treehouse of Horror episodes; Dead Line on 28 October 2018), all traceable.
